title: pylint exits with IndexError on python3.5 when a class with async function is defined previously and a function references self
body:
### Steps to reproduce

``` bash
VENV=/tmp/test_pylint
python3.5 -m venv $VENV
cat > $VENV/pylint_bug.py << EOF
class MyClass:
    async def method(self):
        pass


# also possible
# def function(self):
def function():
    assert self.attr
EOF

$VENV/bin/pip install pylint==1.6.4
$VENV/bin/pylint -rn $VENV/pylint_bug.py
```
